name: Portalroot Network
introDiscord:
Living roots stretch through portals without ever crossing the space
between them.

Some disappear into Moonlit Reef.

Others into Whispering Kelp Forest.

Somewhere, a root exits into a place you don't recognize.
introTwitch:
Living roots stretch through portals without ever crossing the space
between them.

Some disappear into Moonlit Reef.

Others into Whispering Kelp Forest.

Somewhere, a root exits into a place you don't recognize.

portalroot-network-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Portalroot Network.

left.message:
One Berry grows from a root connected to somewhere else.

Shizuki wrote:

'Remote berry delivery.

Technology has peaked.'

right.message: A cache is caught between two portalroots.

forward.message: A Portalroot Serpent slides through one root opening.

portalroot-network-depths.prompt: Deeper within Portalroot Network, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: The Serpent disappears into a root and emerges from another.

right.message:
A root connected to Whispering Kelp Forest carries familiar restorative
Fae magic.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: Star Candies grow strangely entangled in the roots.

portalroot-network-threshold.prompt: Near Worldtree Junction, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A cache hangs from a root connected to Starfall Trench.

right.message: A Portalroot Serpent coils around the junction.

forward.message: A root carrying Moonlit Reef's gentle current restores you.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Worldtree Junction
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Worldtree Junction gathers hundreds of portalroots into one enormous
living knot.

bossPromptDiscord:
Worldtree Junction gathers hundreds of portalroots into one enormous
living knot.

Something ancient moves inside.

Use /yes to approach or /no to avoid discovering what uses
interdimensional roots as tunnels.
bossPromptTwitch:
Worldtree Junction gathers hundreds of portalroots into one enormous
living knot.

Something ancient moves inside.

Use !yes to approach or !no to avoid discovering what uses
interdimensional roots as tunnels.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Worldtree Junction. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Roots split apart around an immense Serpent.

Gate-Root Serpent reveals itself!

completionText:
The roots settle.

One tiny new shoot points somewhere beyond the known regions.

Shizuki circled it.

No label.
